observations.question: Top 2 blue products by highest stock_on_hand on 2022-12-31.
Top 2 products by highest stock_on_hand on 2022-12-31, only color='blue'.
observations.sql: SELECT i.snapshot_date,i.product_id,i.stock_on_hand*2 FROM commerce.inventory i JOIN commerce.products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date=$1 AND p.color=$2 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST,i.product_id LIMIT 2
